findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: Read-only receipt snapshots destructively finalize hashes and break every normal positive proof
findings.trigger: A normal receipt is proven by #proveDomainGone, which calls accumulator.state(); the success path next calls #receiptEligibility, which calls state() on the same three Hash objects again. inspectCleanup also invokes state before later segments/proof.
findings.impact: state uses Hash.digest rather than a non-consuming snapshot. Second digest throws ERR_CRYPTO_HASH_FINALIZED, and an earlier inspection also prevents later update(). The catch then invokes #fail -> #proveDomainGone -> state again, so the void #run can reject without settling the issued promise. Small normal ASCII protocol cannot complete even with perfect kernel/receipt behavior.
findings.contract: Private contract A inspectCleanup read-only and normal positive route; R3 SPEC3 segmented receipt and SPEC8 actual orchestration tests.
findings.minimalFix: Make state a non-mutating immutable snapshot (e.g. copy each hash before digest), preserve live accumulators for later segments, and prevent error-cleanup proof from throwing outside owned handoff.
findings.actualBranchMock: Feed real cacheInterpretControlMessage/CacheReceiptAccumulator, call state twice, inspect between segments, then validate domain and eligibility on the same accumulator; drive the supervisor returned-child/event branch to actual settlement. Current tests call state only once per newly created accumulator.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: After authorization, exact synthetic normal N roundtrip must return the expected buffer and permit repeated active/terminal inspect calls without altering seq/digests or settlement.

findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: The nofork pilot still declares cleanup complete after timeout and lacks asynchronous startup ownership
findings.trigger: Any nofork identity assertion/startup failure or delayed close enters endChild. Its fresh close listener may miss an already emitted close; it races 2/3/5s timers then returns void. terminated===true can never match a close promise resolving void. The case unconditionally sets pilot.settled=true. Direct spawn and channels have no error listeners.
findings.impact: It can mark cleanup successful without actual close, attempt a needless KILL after an observed close, or crash on asynchronous spawn/socket error. This is a genuine first-stage safety blocker before any AUTHORIZE_FORK. The positive pilot also has no cancel/reap finally: it merely inspects and may discard its registered owner via owned.splice while resources remain held.
findings.contract: R3 SPEC7: first identity pilot must safely fail, immediate child/close ownership, deadline never means ended, live owner/evidence retained.
findings.minimalFix: Register persistent error/exit/close facts at spawn, use an unambiguous close result, never signal a proven exited child, and set settled only after real nofork C close/reap. On timeout retain a live owned handle and report unknown, not return successful cleanup. For positive stage, bind supervisor+issued handle+actual child/domain owner into the registry and provide a real exact-owned cleanup/reconcile finally; never KILL a forked C as fallback.
findings.actualBranchMock: Returned fake ChildProcess emits close before cleanup, exit before delayed close, error with no PID, and delayed/no close; assert truthful terminal/unknown state and no post-exit signal attempts. Deliberately throw an assertion after birth. Stub the actual endChild ownership flow, not a separate boolean helper.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: First authorized case sends no AUTHORIZE_FORK, intentionally fails an assertion after HELLO, and still records exact C epoch/exit/close before ending; unknown must preserve owner/output. Positive-N cleanup is a separate later case.

findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: Real writable wait references a nonexistent custodian field
findings.trigger: A real control write gets EAGAIN and _queue_segment or _flush_receipt calls _wait_writable. It reads self._control_write, which is assigned nowhere (only _control_read and ControlWriter(CONTROL_FD) exist).
findings.impact: AttributeError escapes; main returns2 instead of resuming output. Raw resources have already been reaped in this branch, so this is lost settlement proof, not an invented live-child orphan. The current unit replaces _wait_writable with a lambda and masks the error.
findings.contract: R3 SPEC3 actual final writable drain and bounded exact receipt delivery.
findings.minimalFix: Use the actual owned fd4 write endpoint with lifecycle checks; exercise the real select boundary and classify errors without fabricated success.
findings.actualBranchMock: Mock select.select only, leave _wait_writable and _flush_receipt intact; force EAGAIN then a later writable notification and assert fd4, exact frame bytes and successful flush. Test disconnect after raw reaping as explicit non-success.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: Authorized control backpressure/resume must preserve all segment seq/digests and finish receipt plus C close; Host disconnect still locally reaps first.

findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: Resource-ended proof still rejects legitimate failed startup and cannot reconcile preHELLO failures
findings.trigger: N exec fails with a real errno or setsid fails: C retains/reaps N and emits an outcome=reaped receipt with exec.ok=false. Host domain validator requires successful exec whenever forked_pid is non-null, so cleanup is held despite actual ECHILD/group gone. reconcile then rejects facts.worker===null. Separately asynchronous spawn-no-child emits error/close but no exit; custodianBorn is written but never used by the proof, which requires custodianExit.
findings.impact: Normal infrastructure failure cannot return its original failure after complete cleanup; PRE/scope/run directory stay held permanently with no live C to obtain a different receipt. Installed error listeners prevent a Host crash but do not close the no-birth lifecycle.
findings.contract: R3 SPEC2 explicitly separates raw execution-ended from result-success; SPEC1/4 preHELLO and asynchronous error branches must finish or retain real unknown responsibility.
findings.minimalFix: Model no-birth, failed setup/exec and successful exec as distinct authenticated fork outcomes. Accept complete raw cleanup for a failed exec while refusing picture eligibility; allow reconcile using retained C/fork identity before N_HELLO. For verified no-child spawn error+actual close, do not require an exit event that Node does not emit; never treat arbitrary error as no-birth.
findings.actualBranchMock: Drive actual returned ChildProcess error/close-without-exit and actual supervisor FORKED exec-failure message flow. Domain cleanup succeeds as a failed result with original errno; business eligibility remains false. Test preHELLO C death remains held.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: After positive baseline, authorized missing-worker exec, setsid failure and no-child spawn-error cases must actually reap/close and release once with original error, alongside C-dies-after-fork failclosed control.

findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: Unknown N identity can skip escalation and make a live TERM-ignore domain unrecoverable
findings.trigger: After controlled fork, C's exec/settlement identity reads are unknown so worker_identity is still None. _target_census only reads N when worker_identity exists and skips worker_pid in direct_children. Thus it can claim no live/unknown target despite live N; it goes straight to _reap_worker, times out without sending KILL. Recovery later sees a known TERM-ignoring N, but every _settle_domain(resignal=False) starts escalated and never sends any KILL.
findings.impact: C and anchor are retained (R3A expiry fix works), but the domain never actively ends after census readability recovers. This is permanent held substituting for the promised actionable cleanup, not a remaining60s exit. Existing adapter/recovery tests prepopulate worker_identity and miss this branch.
findings.contract: R3 SPEC1 unknown must be represented from actual fork authority, and ordinary TERM-ignore must complete via retained owned TERM/KILL/wait rather than permanent held.
findings.minimalFix: Always account for the unreaped forked N even before any accepted identity; unknown read must produce unknown census. Retain action/escalation state across recovery and permit the still-required exact-owned KILL after identity/authority becomes known, without resending blind group signals or losing N anchor.
findings.actualBranchMock: Use actual _settle_domain -> KernelSettlementOperations with worker_pid set but worker_identity=None, first reads unknown then known live, waitpid returns0 until a verified KILL. Assert N never reaped under uncertainty and eventual KILL/adopted waits/Nlast when readable; do not seed the fake with a ready zombie.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: Authorized preHELLO/late identity-read failure and restored readability, with actual TERM-ignore N, must complete and preserve peer; no repeated unsafe signals or responsibility deadline.

findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: Matching digests/counts still do not validate actual wait/identity semantics
findings.trigger: A receipt segment contains one arbitrary wait value (wrong PID, nonterminal status, or adopted wait after N) and arbitrary identity values. Counts/digests are recomputed consistently and all summary booleans/epochs match. Accumulator stores only counters/hashes/PID uniqueness and validator merely requires waits>=1.
findings.impact: The shared domain validator accepts a transcript without N's actual terminal wait, without N-last ordering, or without identity epoch/wait correspondence. Segment protocol/draw/ticket fields are not individually checked either. This is a private protocol/fault seam contract defect, not a claim of an external public attacker or observed kernel false reap.
findings.contract: R3 SPEC2/3 require actual fork/wait/identity semantics, full epoch binding, segment binding and complete N-last evidence, not self-consistent body counts.
findings.minimalFix: Track bounded semantic wait/identity facts as segments arrive: validate shape/status, full required epochs, N exactly once and last, known target completion or explicit parent-reaped category, sequence/binding and summary agreement. Preserve raw failure cleanup eligibility separately from creative success.
findings.actualBranchMock: Use actual accumulator+validator with valid digests but wrong/missing N wait, reordered N/adopted waits, duplicate/nonterminal waits, missing/bad epochs and foreign segment draw/ticket. Each must reject; use one real-shaped normal C transcript as positive fixture.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: Actual C/N/adopted terminal waits, Nlast, ECHILD/group ESRCH and exact epochs must match the segmented transcript; do not replace the runtime proof with mock transcript validation.

findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: Diagnostic accounting stops as soon as settlement begins
findings.trigger: After FINALIZE/CANCEL switches from _run_loop to TargetSettlement, N/descendants write stdout/stderr (e.g. TERM handler), then exit. KernelSettlementOperations.sleep only sleeps and _wait_for_recovery ignores stream events. There is no final stream drain before receipt.
findings.impact: Already detected overflow now latches correctly, but bytes emitted during settlement/recovery can remain unread and be omitted from stdout_bytes/stderr_bytes. A candidate can be eligible despite actual cumulative output exceeding64KiB; full diagnostics/FD-drained claims are unsupported by actual code. This is not a claim that elapsed cleanup proves settlement.
findings.contract: ADR F07 and R3 SPEC2/4 every-phase diagnostics budget and original failure preservation.
findings.minimalFix: Service bounded stream reads throughout settlement/recovery without starving wait/cancel, and prove stream EOF/final bounded drain after targets end before emitting counts. Read failures must be explicit unknown/lost diagnostics and disqualify success while permitting proven raw failure cleanup.
findings.actualBranchMock: Drive actual KernelSettlementOperations/Custodian phases with late stdout on TERM and total just over64KiB, then real-shaped waits; assert actual drain/latch/counts, not merely manually setting diagnostics_lost in validator input.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: Authorized candidate-then-late stdout/stderr and TERM-handler output cases must account every emitted byte, reap domain, and reject success at the limit; normal bounded output remains successful.

findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: Identity budget failure becomes an irreversible responsibility hold even after all children end
findings.trigger: More than512 actual target identities are seen. _record_target sets _identity_overflow permanently; _known_targets_gone immediately returnsFalse forever, even after actual adopted/N waits, ECHILD and group ESRCH succeeded.
findings.impact: _recover can never return proven cleanup and C remains forever with no children; no original budget failure is latched there. Event truncation similarly makes delivered domain proof permanently inadmissible. Bounded bookkeeping is necessary, but cannot replace a resource-ended failed outcome with permanent held once raw ending is genuinely provable.
findings.contract: R3 SPEC2: independent budget failure must not become permanent held after domain is reaped; no new expiry is requested or permitted.
findings.minimalFix: Use bounded authoritative wait/target proof and fail budget eligibility at overflow while retaining real ownership until raw cleanup is independently complete. Define a verifiable failed terminal transcript for overflow rather than dropping needed authority or blindly clearing the flag; do not add a responsibility timeout.
findings.actualBranchMock: Actual _record_target overflow -> settlement/recovery with all actual children waited, known retained epochs gone, ECHILD and group ESRCH true; assert eventual failed terminal outcome with original budget error. Separately real unknown/live target must still retain C/N authority.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: Only after smaller pilots, approved bounded overflow stress must end all owned children and return failure without orphan, unbounded memory or permanent empty custodian.

findings.runtime: NOT_RUN; static counterfactual only, not captured old-code failure
findings.title: Adopted TERM-ignore helper still has no ready/liveness barrier before leader leaves
findings.trigger: If the existing ignore-term-adopted helper mode is selected, it returns immediately after spawn and main process.exit; C may deliver TERM before the grandchild installs its handler/writes child-alive. No ready/adoption/TERM-survival barrier is implemented.
findings.impact: The EPIPE source is fixed by ignore stdio plus an owned events sink, but this fault helper can still exercise early TERM death instead of a live adopted TERM-ignoring child. Current lifecycle file contains only nofork and normal stages; this is a scaffold defect to fix before later adoption testing, not an accusation that an existing ISO runtime passed or that missing kernel tests alone are a defect.
findings.contract: R3 SPEC7 explicit same-epoch adopted/TERM-survived mode reached before KILL, no accidental simpler branch as ISO proof.
findings.minimalFix: Add an owned child-ready handshake and record/require same epoch adopted PPID=C plus post-TERM liveness before escalation; unexpected early child exit must fail the case and still clean precisely.
findings.actualBranchMock: Check actual scenario orchestration waits for child readiness and consumes adoption/TERM records; a missing-ready or early-exit branch must be failure.
findings.futureDecisiveRuntime: After normal pilot, observe child same startticks live under C and TERM handler recorded before actual KILL/wait; early TERM exit must make adoption case red.

findings.title: 普通拒绝及真实失败拿不到完整阶段凭证，永久占住 whole-production scope
findings.trigger: 有效 workspace production 在 scope 获准后因已有 unwitnessed output 拒绝；或 bridge 的原生 seek/JOB/producer 业务失败，但 execution 与真实 parent drain 均已经完成。
findings.actual_branch: 三个 workspace phase lease 在 821–823 全部打开；953 的普通拒绝在资源 try 之前，未标明 NOT_OWNED。生产源码没有 notOwned() 调用。bridge 失败时 1782 throw 原 primary，OpenFilmDrawResult 只在成功返回；989 因 drawn=null 不 settle parent_drain。outer finally 仅 settle execution，mint 返回 null 后标 held。
findings.impact: 无残留资源的普通失败也永久封住物理 root/额度；前置拒绝无 bridge handle 或 pending production 可恢复。业务失败也无法凭实际 parent drain 结束原 scope。scope helper 的 NOT_OWNED 正向测试未覆盖此调用路径。
findings.contract: 060P1R_PRIVATE_CONTRACT A：未拥有阶段由真实构造事实标记 NOT_OWNED；业务失败与资源结算分离，清理完成后原错误返回且释放 scope。R3 SPEC §5。
findings.minimal_fix: workspace 按真实获取点标记未开始/未拥有阶段；bridge 用 issuer-bound 的私有 outcome/completion 路径在成功和失败两支都向同一 workspace owner 交付 parent-drain 事实及原错误，不依赖成功 DTO 或 caller 布尔自证。所有已结阶段完成后一次消费 completion/释放。
findings.actual_branch_mock: 经真实 workspace produce 路径制造 preexisting 和排队后 stale；断言 root idle/下一次同 root 可准入且无子进程出生。mock 真 bridge/supervisor 边界回原业务错误同时 drain 成立，断言 parent phase 结束、原错误对象不变、scope 一次释放。
findings.future_decisive_runtime: 具名后续生产 pilot 制造一个真实 seek/JOB 失败，收齐 execution/parent/tree 收据，原错误返回后同 root 正常 draw 成功。

findings.title: 原生成功但 tree release 失败仍提前 reject，绕过原 promise barrier
findings.trigger: draw/POST/record 均成功，primary 未设；PRE 或 POST 的 descriptor close 真实抛错。
findings.actual_branch: 1107 的 #holdProduction 仅在 primary!==undefined 内；1110–1117 成功清理失败分支直接 throw。work rejection 从 #operations 删除，而 scope 仅留 held 标志，原 closure 未进入 #pendingProductions。close 的 allSettled 随原 work 结束，dispose 可继续关闭和 rm root。
findings.impact: 资源未知时完整责任/promise 已结束；不能通过生产 inspect/reconcile 找回原 tree，dispose 可越过仍不确定的 retained allocation。
findings.contract: ADR rev3 §1/§3 F04/F10；private contract A 要求所有 tree 未证分支保留原 continuation/PRE/scope，不能仅留 held 计数。
findings.minimal_fix: 把成功后的 cleanup failure 转为锁存原失败后，进入与业务失败相同的持责分支；保留两 tree 和原 work promise，close/dispose 等待真实 fresh settlement，不能先 throw。也覆盖 tree open 自身携带 genuine cleanup uncertainty 的路径。
findings.actual_branch_mock: 真实 workspace 调用先完成合法 candidate/POST，注入一个 allocation-specific close failure；断言 work/close/dispose 都不完成、无 rm，inspect 返回原责任；fresh proof 后才按原 cleanup failure 结束并释放一次。
findings.future_decisive_runtime: 后续受控 FD close 故障/确认恢复 pilot；记录 work、close、dispose、root 删除与真实 allocation 终局时间序。

findings.title: reconcile 把 release 的幂等 no-op 当 fresh tree 结束证明
findings.trigger: 原业务失败且 tree close 失败进入 #holdProduction；Host 用该 service 的真实 opaque handle 调 reconcile。
findings.actual_branch: RetainedNativeClosure 在 close 尝试前置 descriptor.released=true；close 抛错时 sticky uncertain，且合同明确 allocation 至多尝试一次、从不重试。第二次 release 见 closed && rootDescriptor.released 直接 return。workspace 据该无异常返回 settle tree_release，忽略 #finalizeProductionScope 的 false，删 pending 并 reject 原 promise，返回 settled:true/parent_drained:true。
findings.impact: 没有任何 fresh allocation 证明也能声称树清理完成；若 parent 已结会归还未知资源的 root；若 parent 未结，仍错误地结束原 barrier、谎报 settled。并非要求重试可复用的数字 FD。
findings.contract: private contract A 完成凭证须来自真实阶段终局；ADR F02/F04/F10 unknown 不得当 gone。retained-native-closure 自身 at-most-once/sticky-uncertain 合同。
findings.minimal_fix: reconcile 使用 allocation-bound 的新鲜终局凭证；既有 release 返回不能清除 sticky uncertainty。无安全恢复接口时继续持责并明确需 MAIN 决定，不能盲重试 fd。只有全部 phase 和 completion consumption 成功才删 pending、settle 原 work、返回 whole-settled；parent 状态读取真实 lease，不能硬编码 true。
findings.actual_branch_mock: 使用真实 RetainedNativeClosure + 注入 close hook 令一次 allocation close 抛错；第二次 release 为 no-op 时 reconcile 必须仍 held、pending/close/dispose 不结束、root 不归还。另测缺 parent lease 时 finalize=false 不得返回 settled。
findings.future_decisive_runtime: 在精确授权的 FD 实验中保存 allocation identity/close 证据，验证没有新鲜终局不能解除 held，避免复用 fd 误关闭 peer。

findings.title: direct bridge 的 handle 在 await 获准后创建，未进入可恢复 map
findings.trigger: 合法 issued serving bridge.draw 从无 ambient workspace scope 的 direct 路径调用，scope 等待之后 reserve 出 handle，随后 execution cleanup-held。
findings.actual_branch: pageFrame 首 await 前登记 responsibility 但 handle=null。bridge 在 1722 仅同步插入非 null handle；direct acquire 即使立即可准入也跨 await。672 后 handle 被赋值，但无后续 unsettled.set。inspect 遍历 map、reconcile 仅查此 map，因此该实际 direct draw 永远不可见。ambient workspace 已持 scope 的一支可同步 reserve，不能证明 direct 分支。
findings.impact: 真实 direct draw 的 held execution 无 bridge Host-only 恢复入口，producer/owner close 与原 promise 可永久等待；同 bridge 多责任改造未完整接线。
findings.contract: private contract A / ADR F04 要求 queue 到结算责任和真实 issued handle 在生产恢复面可达；R3 SPEC §6。
findings.minimal_fix: 以同步签发的 responsibility token 注册 bridge membership，再在同一责任 reserve 时绑定实际 handle；或提供 owner-private reserve notification 并在赋值处同步登记。不能靠一次 last-pointer snapshot，不能开放任意 foreign handle。
findings.actual_branch_mock: 经真实 direct factory + bridge 调用，令 scope acquire 跨 microtask，mock supervisor 在 start 后 held；inspect 必须看见原 handle，reconcile 推进原 continuation。再测 A held/B queued、foreign bridge/service 拒绝。
findings.future_decisive_runtime: 单 slot 后续 direct bridge 持责恢复对照，记录 handle->C->root 与原 promise/drain 顺序。

findings.title: 首个 nofork pilot 仍把 timeout 当 close；positive pilot 未登记完整 supervisor owner
findings.trigger: nofork C 已 exit 但 close 延迟/在 endChild 监听前已发生，或 TERM/KILL 后 close 始终未到；positive case start 进入 held，或建根/前置断言/constructor/reserve 早抛。
findings.actual_branch: ownChild 只保存 child，没有首时刻 close/error ledger；endChild 的 void Promise.race 在超时仍返回，void close 的 terminated===true 永远不成立；finally 无条件 settled=true，afterEach 又重调 endChild。positive OwnedPilot 只有 root/child/boolean，真实 supervisor+handle 不登记到该 owner；finally 只读 inspect，没有 cancel/reconcile/清理接续；createPilotRoot 在 ownRoot 前已 mkdtemp/写 helper，reserve 和前置 expect 在 try 外。
findings.impact: 即便只跑第一个无 AUTHORIZE_FORK case，也不能证明 C 真实 close/reap或安全报告未知；不能给该现成 case STATIC_SAFE。positive helper 的失败可留下不可恢复的 owner/原 scope，afterEach 保根抛错本身不等于持有完整可恢复责任。
findings.contract: R3 SPEC §8、ADR §5 P2a 与 private contract D：首 pilot 在全部 await/expect 前登记完整 owner，真实 close 才结算，未知保全且有恢复路径。
findings.minimal_fix: spawn 当下注册一次共享 error/exit/close ledger，endChild 返回区分 closed/unknown 的真实结果并使用正确 tagged result，不以 timeout/kill throw 当 close。nofork 独立 case 的 finally 仅在 close/reap 确认后标 settled，否则保存 owner 与明确失败。positive root 创建即登记，supervisor/handle 在创建/ reserve 时同步归属，所有后续步骤在 finally 范围，持有 cancel/inspect/reconcile 接续；不要因测试超时或 retained root 就丢 owner。
findings.actual_branch_mock: 真实 pilot orchestration 的 child adapter 注入 close-before-cleanup、exit-before-delayed-close、TERM 后 close、永无 close、spawn error、kill throw；判定未知不能 settled。positive 注入构造/ reserve/expect/start-held，逐项验证根和唯一 supervisor/handle 责任均可恢复。
findings.future_decisive_runtime: 先单独精确筛选 nofork case（不跑整文件），正常及断言失败均观察同一个 C 的真实 close/reap；通过后另票一次 normal N receipt，保留失败 owner，不并跑 TERM-ignore/adoption/flood。

scope_note: No-fork capability pilot only advances kernel baseline; does not close production findings, original17, ISO18, N1N2 or NEXT
